method: Bounded method, executed 2026-09-12: for each lab, the official domain(s) were fetched directly and the HTTP status of every checked URL recorded; the site robots.txt/sitemap.xml were enumerated where served; and a bounded site-restricted web search (site:<domain>) was run for frontier-safety / preparedness / responsible-scaling framework documents. A lab appears under PUBLISHED only when an official framework document URL returned HTTP 200 and the document content was inspected. A lab appears under EMPTY CHAIRS only when the checks listed in its row found no such document. Version and date fields are recorded only where printed on the official page or document itself. Absence is a presence measurement, not a safety finding.

published.source_note: Version and date read from the document cover ('Preparedness Framework Version 2. Last updated: 15th April, 2025'). The announcement page https://openai.com/index/updating-our-preparedness-framework/ (dated April 15, 2025 on the page itself) links this PDF. openai.com HTML pages answer non-browser agents with an HTTP 403 bot challenge; the document URL above returned HTTP 200 to curl.

Current version and effective date read from the version history printed on the page ('Version 3.4 ... (effective July 8, 2026)'). The linked Version 3.4 PDF at https://cdn.sanity.io/files/4zrzovbb/website/0bacdc8440ea96e62a8766d99ebe1d4eea6d5f3a.pdf also returned HTTP 200.

The official frontier-safety page prints the version list: 'Version 1.0 (17 May 2024)', 'Version 2.0 (4 Feb 2025)', 'Version 3.0 (22 Sep 2025)', 'Version 3.1 (17 Apr 2026)' — 3.1 is the latest listed.

published.framework: Advanced AI Scaling Framework (previously Frontier AI Framework)
published.source_note: The PDF cover reads 'Advanced AI Scaling Framework — Version 2' and states the framework was previously titled the Frontier AI Framework. The announcement post https://ai.meta.com/blog/scaling-how-we-build-test-advanced-ai/ is dated April 8, 2026 on the page and links this PDF. The former /blog/frontier-ai-framework/ URL now returns 404. ai.meta.com blocks non-browser requests (HTTP 400/500 to curl); the PDF returned HTTP 200 (application/pdf) in a real browser session.

The document cover reads 'xAI Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework — Effective Date: 30 June 2026'. The PDF is linked from https://x.ai/safety; x.ai HTML pages answer non-browser agents with an HTTP 403 bot challenge, so the linking page was loaded in a real browser session while the document URL returned HTTP 200 to curl.
